Description: Unique crossing identifier from the Statewide Asset Data Exchange System (SADES). Used as the join key across every sheet and against the Beta v2 baseline.
Plain-language location label built as 'stream at road, town' from StreamName, RoadNameF (or STREET) and Town. Where the stream is unnamed in SADES the label reads 'Unnamed stream'.
Road owner or maintaining authority, copied from the OWNERSHIP_ field of the NHDOT road inventory (for example TOWN, PRIVATE, DISTRICT 6).
Municipality recorded during the SADES field assessment.
Municipality from the NHDOT road inventory join.
Named water body at the crossing, where one is recorded in SADES.
Road name recorded during the SADES field assessment.
Alternate road name recorded during the SADES field assessment.
Road name from the NHDOT road inventory join.
Road ownership description from the NHDOT road inventory. Source field for Landowner.
Hydraulic capacity status at the 2-year return period: Overtop, Vulnerable, or Pass.
Hydraulic capacity status at the 10-year return period: Overtop, Vulnerable, or Pass.
Hydraulic capacity status at the 25-year return period: Overtop, Vulnerable, or Pass.
Hydraulic capacity status at the 50-year return period: Overtop, Vulnerable, or Pass.
Hydraulic capacity status at the 100-year return period: Overtop, Vulnerable, or Pass.

Hydraulic capacity score, 0 to 1. Maximum sub-score across the available return periods, so the worst failure mode governs. Overtop and Vulnerable at a more frequent event score higher. Pass scores 0. NaN only where no hydraulic capacity data exist, for example wetland crossings.

Documented flooding history flag (black flag). Displayed as 'Flooded' where a flood record is present. Points are centroids of flooded-area polygons from NH Town Hazard Mitigation Plans snapped to the nearest stream-road crossing within 500 ft.
Flooding history score. 1 where flooding is documented; NaN where no record exists, because an unlabeled crossing may lack documentation rather than lack flood risk.
Hydraulic capacity score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Flooding history score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Flood Vulnerability goal score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of the available criterion scores.
Flood Vulnerability goal score after min-max normalization to 0 to 1 across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on FVScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only; the goal sheets report the mean-substituted rank.
Jenks natural-breaks class of FVScr, Very Low to Very High. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Flood Vulnerability criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Flood Vulnerability criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Flood Vulnerability, reported as 'present of total' criteria. A score built on few criteria is less reliable than one built on all of them.
Mean-substituted Flood Vulnerability score. Missing goal scores are filled with the mean of the non-missing goal scores before ranking and classification.
Dense rank on FVScrMS, 1 = highest priority. This is the rank reported in the Beta v2 workbook.
FVScrMS after min-max normalization to 0 to 1 across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of FVScrMS, Very Low to Very High. This is the class reported in the Beta v2 workbook.
Upstream undermining inventory (None, Footers, Culvert, Wing Walls, Abutments, and combinations).
Downstream undermining inventory (None, Footers, Culvert, Wing Walls, Abutments, and combinations).
Obstruction of the structure opening recorded in the field.
Scour of the streambed at the outlet: None, Low, Medium, or High.
Extent to which the structure is filled with sediment: Open, 1/4 Full, 1/2 Full, 3/4 Full, or High.
Upstream bank erosion: None, Low, or High.
Downstream bank erosion: None, Low, or High.
Upstream bank armoring: Intact or Failing.
Downstream bank armoring: Intact or Failing.
Upstream undermining scour score. None scores 0; any undermining category scores 1; blank is NaN. Severity gradation within the undermining categories is not retained.
Downstream undermining scour score. None scores 0; any undermining category scores 1; blank is NaN.
Opening obstruction score. None scores 0; any other recorded value scores 1; blank is NaN.
Outlet streambed scour score. None 0, Low 0.33, Medium 0.66, High 1; blank is NaN.
Sediment fill score. Open and 1/4 Full score 0, 1/2 Full 0.33, 3/4 Full 0.66, High 1; blank is NaN.
Upstream bank erosion score. None 0, Low 0.5, High 1; blank is NaN.
Downstream bank erosion score. None 0, Low 0.5, High 1; blank is NaN.
Upstream bank armoring score. Intact 0, Failing 1; blank is NaN.
Downstream bank armoring score. Intact 0, Failing 1; blank is NaN.
Erosion criterion score, 0 to 1. Arithmetic mean of the nine erosion components that have data; components without data are skipped.
Jenks natural-breaks class of ErosScr, Very Low to Very High.
Geomorphic compatibility category recorded in the field: Fully Compatible, Mostly Compatible, Partially Compatible, Mostly Incompatible, or Fully Incompatible.

Geomorphic compatibility score. Fully Compatible 0, Mostly Compatible 0.25, Partially Compatible 0.50, Mostly Incompatible 0.75, Fully Incompatible 1. NaN only where no geomorphic compatibility data exist.

Reach-scale water quality impairment flag, displayed as 'Impaired'. Built from the NHDES Surface Water Quality Assessment, integrated reporting categories 4 and 5, for eight nutrient and eutrophication parameters.

Water quality impairment score. Impaired 1, not impaired 0. A crossing that is not flagged corresponds to a water body evaluated and found not to meet the impairment filter, so 0 is a determined absence rather than missing data.
Watershed water quality impairment flag. 1 where the crossing falls inside a HUC12-clipped impaired lake or impoundment watershed.
Display form of WWQI, shown as 'Impaired' where the crossing falls inside an impaired watershed.
Watershed water quality impairment score. Inside an impaired HUC12-clipped watershed 1, otherwise 0. New criterion in the Pilot and Beta v2 models.
Assessment unit identifiers of the impaired water bodies intersecting the crossing, carried as a reference attribute.
Impaired parameters recorded for the intersecting assessment units, carried as a reference attribute.
Erosion score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Geomorphic compatibility score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Water quality impairment score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Watershed water quality impairment score multiplied by the water quality criterion weight.
Environmental Quality goal score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of erosion and geomorphic compatibility, with the two water quality criteria admitted only when the erosion score is positive.
Environmental Quality goal score after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on EQScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
Jenks natural-breaks class of EQScr. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Environmental Quality criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Environmental Quality criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Environmental Quality, reported as 'present of total' criteria.
Mean-substituted Environmental Quality score.
Dense rank on EQScrMS, 1 = highest priority.
EQScrMS after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of EQScrMS, Very Low to Very High.
Condition of the structure recorded in the field: Poor, Fair, or Good.
Condition of the inlet (upstream) headwall: Poor, Fair, or Good.
Condition of the outlet (downstream) headwall: Poor, Fair, or Good.
Structure condition score. Poor 1, Fair 0.5, Good 0.
Inlet headwall condition score. Poor 1, Fair 0.5, Good 0.
Outlet headwall condition score. Poor 1, Fair 0.5, Good 0.
Combined condition score. With all three present, 0.5 structure plus 0.3 inlet plus 0.2 outlet; with two present the weights are renormalized; with one present that value is used directly.
Structure type recorded in the field. Round Culvert triggers the circular opening-area formula.
Upstream structure width, feet.
Upstream structure opening height, feet.

Upstream opening area, square feet. Computed as pi/4 times width squared for round culverts and width times opening height otherwise. A computed area of 0 is treated as NaN because a zero opening is physically infeasible.

Size score from binned opening area. Over 0 to 7.07 sq ft scores 0; over 7.07 to 12.5 scores 0.02; over 12.5 to 16 scores 0.184; over 16 to 38.5 scores 0.51; over 38.5 scores 1. The 7.07 sq ft break is the area of a 3 ft diameter round culvert.
Construction material of the structure.
Material score. Steel-Corrugated, Steel-Smooth and Aluminum-Corrugated score 1; Masonry and Stone 0.25; Concrete 0.111; Plastic-Corrugated and Plastic-Smooth 0.028; Other and Wood 0.
Depth of soil cover over the structure, feet. Retained as a field attribute only. The depth of cover criterion was removed from Structural Risk in the Pilot model and is not scored.
Condition score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Size score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Material score multiplied by its criterion weight.

Structural Risk goal score, 0 to 1. When the condition score is present and greater than 0, condition, size and material all enter the dynamic weighted average. When the condition score is 0 (Good) or missing, size is dropped.
Structural Risk goal score after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on SRScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
Jenks natural-breaks class of SRScr. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Structural Risk criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Structural Risk criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Structural Risk, reported as 'present of total' criteria.
Mean-substituted Structural Risk score.
Dense rank on SRScrMS, 1 = highest priority.
SRScrMS after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of SRScrMS, Very Low to Very High.
Annual average daily traffic on the road segment carrying the crossing, from the NHDOT road inventory.

AADT score from left-closed bins. Under 2,000 scores 0.028; 2,000 to 4,000 scores 0.111; 4,000 to 6,000 scores 0.25; 6,000 to 10,000 scores 0.444; 10,000 to 20,000 scores 0.694; 20,000 and above scores 1.
Distance from the crossing to the nearest hospital, miles.
Distance from the crossing to the nearest emergency medical service, miles.
Distance from the crossing to the nearest law enforcement facility, miles.
Distance from the crossing to the nearest fire station, miles.
Minimum of the four distances to important services, miles.

Distance to important services score. 0 to 0.5 miles scores 1; over 0.5 to 1 scores 0.75; over 1 to 1.5 scores 0.5; over 1.5 to 2 scores 0.25; over 2 scores 0. Crossings beyond 2 miles are scored rather than excluded.

FHWA functional classification of the road carried by the crossing. 1 Interstate, 2 Other Freeways and Expressways, 3 Other Principal Arterial, 4 Minor Arterial, 5 Major Collector, 6 Minor Collector, 7 Local, 0 unclassified.
Functional classification score. Class 1 scores 1; 2 scores 0.833; 3 scores 0.667; 4 scores 0.5; 5 scores 0.33; 6 scores 0.167; 7 and 0 score 0.
AADT score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Distance to services score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Functional classification score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Road Criticality goal score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of the available criterion scores.
Road Criticality goal score after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on RCScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
Jenks natural-breaks class of RCScr. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Road Criticality criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Road Criticality criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Road Criticality, reported as 'present of total' criteria.
Mean-substituted Road Criticality score.
Dense rank on RCScrMS, 1 = highest priority.
RCScrMS after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of RCScrMS, Very Low to Very High.
Aquatic organism passage category assessed in the field: Full Passage, Reduced Passage, Passage only for Adult Trout, or No Passage.
Aquatic organism passage score. Full Passage 0, Reduced Passage 0.33, Passage only for Adult Trout 0.66, No Passage 1. NaN only where no AOP data exist.

Special species presence flag, displayed as 'Present'. Source: NH Fish and Game, six priority fish species (American Brook Lamprey, American Shad, River Herring, Sea Lamprey, wild Eastern Brook Trout, Red-fin Pickerel).

Special species score. Confirmed presence scores 1; absence is NaN, because absence of a record more plausibly reflects incomplete survey coverage than confirmed absence. Admitted to the goal score only when the AOP score is greater than 0.
Wildlife corridor flag, displayed as 'Wildlife Corridor'. Point-in-polygon containment against the NH Fish and Game statewide wildlife connectivity model.

Wildlife corridor score. Inside a mapped corridor 1, otherwise 0. Because the corridor layer is a statewide modeled product, a 0 is a determined absence rather than missing data. New criterion in the Pilot and Beta v2 models.
Aquatic organism passage score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Special species score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Wildlife corridor score multiplied by the terrestrial organism passage criterion weight.
Wildlife Connectivity goal score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of aquatic organism passage, special species (only when AOP is greater than 0), and wildlife corridor.
Wildlife Connectivity goal score after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on WLScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
Jenks natural-breaks class of WLScr. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Wildlife Connectivity criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Wildlife Connectivity criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Wildlife Connectivity, reported as 'present of total' criteria.
Mean-substituted Wildlife Connectivity score.
Dense rank on WLScrMS, 1 = highest priority.
WLScrMS after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of WLScrMS, Very Low to Very High.

Habitat condition tier of the highest-ranked habitat polygon within 100 ft of the crossing, from the 2020 NH Wildlife Action Plan. Tier 1 highest ranked in the state, Tier 2 highest ranked in the biological region, Tier 3 supporting landscape. A tier of 0 (outside any ranked tier) is shown blank.
Numeric habitat condition tier value used as the criterion input. Tier 1 is 1.0, Tier 2 is 0.66, Tier 3 is 0.33, outside any ranked tier is 0.

Habitat Condition Tier criterion score, 0 to 1, taken from HQ_WAP. Renamed from habitat quality in the Pilot model to distinguish the criterion from the Habitat Quality goal. Outside any ranked tier is a real 0, since the Wildlife Action Plan ranking is statewide.
Wetland proximity flag, displayed as 'Wetland Nearby'. A wetland from the National Wetlands Inventory (Riverine excluded) lies within 100 ft of the crossing.
Wetland proximity score. Wetland within 100 ft scores 1, no qualifying wetland within 100 ft scores 0. Every crossing is checked against the same statewide layer, so 0 is a determined absence.
Conservation status flag, displayed as 'Conserved Land'. Conserved or public land from the NH GRANIT Conservation/Public Lands layer lies within 100 ft of the crossing.
Conservation status score. Conserved land within 100 ft scores 1, none within 100 ft scores 0. Every crossing is checked against the same statewide layer, so 0 is a determined absence.
Primary protection type of the nearby conserved land parcel.
Term of protection of the nearby conserved land parcel.
Habitat Condition Tier score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Wetland proximity score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Conservation status score multiplied by its criterion weight.
Habitat Quality goal score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of Habitat Condition Tier, wetland proximity, and conservation status.
Habitat Quality goal score after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Dense rank on HQGScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
Jenks natural-breaks class of HQGScr. Retained in All Results only.
Count of Habitat Quality criteria with data for this crossing.
Count of Habitat Quality criteria without data for this crossing.
Data completeness for Habitat Quality, reported as 'present of total' criteria.
Mean-substituted Habitat Quality score.
Dense rank on HQGScrMS, 1 = highest priority.
HQGScrMS after min-max normalization across the crossings in the run.
Jenks natural-breaks class of HQGScrMS, Very Low to Very High.

Environmental justice score. 1 where the crossing lies inside a disadvantaged community identified by the federal Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool (CEJST), otherwise 0. Enters the total score as a raw binary value and is not normalized or independently classified.
Display form of EJScr, shown as 'disadvantaged' where the crossing lies inside a CEJST-identified disadvantaged community.
Environmental justice score multiplied by the Environmental Justice goal weight.
Environmental justice score multiplied by the Environmental Justice goal weight in the mean-substituted total.
NHDOT road tier of the segment carrying the crossing, used to set the construction cost multiplier.
Text description of the NHDOT road tier.
Cost multiplier by NHDOT road tier. Tiers 1 and 2 use 2.0, Tier 3 uses 1.8, Tier 4 uses 1.2, Tier 5 uses 1.0, Tier 6 uses 1.1, Tier 0 uses 1.0.
First channel bankfull width measurement, feet.
Second channel bankfull width measurement, feet.
Third channel bankfull width measurement, feet.
Mean of the three channel bankfull width measurements, feet.
Required replacement structure width, feet, computed as 1.2 times the average bankfull width plus 2.
Length of the existing structure, feet.

Unrounded planning-level replacement cost estimate, dollars. Computed as CPI times base cost per unit area times structure length times required width times the cost multiplier. A computed cost of 0 is treated as missing.

Planning-level replacement cost estimate rounded for reporting, dollars. Rounding base and direction are set in configs/params.json. This is a screening figure and is not a substitute for a project cost estimate. Cost is reported alongside the priority results and does not enter the priority score.
Normalized Flood Vulnerability score multiplied by the Flood Vulnerability goal weight.

Normalized Structural Risk score multiplied by the Structural Risk goal weight.
Normalized Road Criticality score multiplied by the Road Criticality goal weight.

Total crossing score, 0 to 1. Dynamic weighted average of the normalized goal scores, with Environmental Justice entering as a raw binary value. Retained in All Results only.
Dense rank on TotScr, 1 = highest priority. Retained in All Results only.
TotScr rounded to two decimal places. Retained in All Results only.

Count of criteria with data for this crossing across all goals.
Count of criteria without data for this crossing across all goals.
Overall data completeness, reported as 'present of total' criteria across all goals. A rank built on 2 of 19 criteria is far less reliable than one built on 17 of 19.
Normalized mean-substituted Flood Vulnerability score multiplied by the Flood Vulnerability goal weight.

Mean-substituted total crossing score, 0 to 1. Built from the mean-substituted goal scores, so a crossing missing a goal score is not advantaged or penalized relative to crossings with complete data. This is the headline score of the Beta v2 workbook.
Dense rank on TotScrMS, 1 = highest priority. This is the headline rank of the Beta v2 workbook. Every goal sheet is sorted by it.
TotScrMS rounded to two decimal places for reporting.
Jenks natural-breaks class of TotScrMS, Very Low to Very High. Classes are computed within the set of crossings in this run, so a filtered extent reclassifies against its own distribution.
Blank column for local use. Enter 1 to flag a crossing as a local priority. Nothing in this column feeds back into the model.
Blank column for local use. Enter a short reason for the flag, for example '2020 HazMit Plan' or 'school bus route'.
